title: Adaptive validation harness for shadow and staged rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an adaptive evaluation harness that continuously validates model quality during shadow traffic, A/B tests, and progressive canary flips. The harness will compute hierarchical scorecards (overall quality + safety + hallucination + latency) against compact per-customer and global golden prompt sets, apply statistically-aware thresholds, and drive an auto-rollback trigger API for staged rollouts. Key goals: reduce false-positive rollbacks, support per-customer baselines, and surface explainable regression signals to PM/Design/SE teams.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow pipeline computes scorecards in < 10s per batch and stores results in metrics-store
Per-customer baseline is maintained and updated weekly; new model diff shows significant regression vs baseline for at least two orthogonal metrics before triggering alert
Auto-rollback API can be invoked with a signed policy and will block a canary flip when threshold breach persists for configured window
Dashboards show per-route and per-customer breakdowns with example prompts and model outputs for triage
End-to-end tests for synthetic regressions (safety and hallucination) included and running in CI

technical_notes: Golden sets: compact per-customer shards (~200 prompts) + global core set (~2k prompts) to balance coverage and evaluation cost.
Metrics: use weighted composite score = 0.5*quality + 0.2*safety + 0.2*hallucination_neg + 0.1*(latency_penalty). Normalization performed per-customer baseline.
Statistical gating: two-stage (stream anomaly detector with Bayesian posterior prob, confirmatory batch t-test with FDR correction across metrics).
Auto-rollback policy: requires confirmatory breach across two windows (short: 10m, long: 2h) or explicit manual override from SRE/PM.
Storage: encrypted golden-hash table in discovery-db; raw examples accessible only through restricted console view for triage.
Trade-offs: aggressive thresholds reduce customer exposure to regressions but increase false positives; per-customer baselines mitigate this at cost of more storage/compute.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): instrument shadow pipeline to emit per-request eval vectors and compute streaming deltas
Phase 2 (1 week): implement Bayesian anomaly detector and integrate with metrics-store and alerting
Phase 3 (2 weeks): build confirmatory batch re-eval job that runs against golden shards and exposes signed rollback decision
Phase 4 (1 week): console UI for triage cards + per-customer threshold controls and manual override
Phase 5 (ongoing): collect feedback from first 5 customers, tune thresholds, and harden CI tests
risks_and_mitigations: Noisy signals for low-traffic customers -> mitigation: require cluster-level confirmation and minimum sample size before gating
Storage of sensitive prompts -> mitigation: hash + encryption + access audit + legal review
Rollback churn on A/B tests -> mitigation: require multi-metric confirmation and cooldown windows
